column1: # Thumbnail-probe cross-scale transfer test — does a 384px probe predict the full-res
# s4-vs-s6 winner? Armed cavif (/tmp/statusmeasure/cavif-armed), 8 origins, Q80. 2026-07-06.
# VERDICT: NO — 4/8 transfer. Failures are damaging: MISSES marginal inversions (8414/7050
# s4's small RD edge washes out at 384px -> reads tie -> probe wouldn't remap) and FALSE-FIRES
# on ties (6096 full-res s6 is +0.6 ssim2 better, thumb says s4 -> remap would lose quality).
# A cheap downscaled probe cannot be the monotonicity guarantee. Strong inversions (7028 +1.12,
# 7058 +1.54) DO transfer; only marginal ones fail. Kept as a heuristic reference, not a gate.
